pixel_coordinates: Top-left origin; x right, y down. Fingertip anchor is shared by both frames.
pivot_coordinates: Bottom-left origin; x right, y up. Normalized pivot = (x / width, 1 - y / height).

prompts.normal: Same reference cream softly glossy glove and teal cuff with gold band; back of hand facing viewer, three dorsal seams, index straight up, other fingers curled, thumb at side; transparent background; no skin, nails or motion arc.
prompts.press: Same glove, material, cuff, lighting and dorsal view; gently flex distal index fingertip for press; scale to 92 percent around the shared fingertip anchor.
